name: The Roosevelt New Orleans
positioning: Historic Waldorf Astoria hotel in central New Orleans, open since 1893, one block from the French Quarter (officially The Roosevelt New Orleans, A Waldorf Astoria Hotel)
best_for: Travelers who want a historic hotel one block from the French Quarter
Cocktail lovers drawn to the Sazerac Bar
Couples and groups planning galas, events or weddings

facts.text: The hotel has been open since 1893.
The hotel's address is 130 Roosevelt Way, New Orleans, Louisiana 70112.
The French Quarter is one block from the hotel.
Guest rooms and suites are dressed in rich, warm decor with contemporary amenities.
Rooms have dark mahogany furniture and antique fixtures.
Fountain Lounge has a menu of local dishes.
Teddy's Cafe is a casual coffee and pastry spot.
The hotel has a Waldorf Astoria Spa offering a variety of treatments.
The hotel hosts galas, events and weddings in flexible venues with catering.
Check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM.

highlights.text: The Sazerac Bar has retro murals, and the sazerac cocktail and Ramos gin fizz were both popularized there.
The hotel was once home to Louisiana governor Huey P. Long.
The hotel has a rooftop pool with city views.
The lobby has gilded pillars, marble floors and large crystal chandeliers.
Domenica is the hotel's Italian dining room, with a happy hour.

considerations.text: The hotel is one block from the French Quarter, not inside it.
Condé Nast Traveler places the hotel at the more expensive end of New Orleans accommodations.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have older infrastructure in some areas.
